stories.title: Iran's army calls on US to compensate for war costs, then leave region
stories.summary: Army Spokesperson Mohammad Akraminia added that all the problems of the US army in the region and the difficulties of the Americans are caused by Washington's mistakes
article_sentences: The US authorities must compensate for all the damage caused to the countries of the Middle East as a result of the war they have unleashed, and withdraw their forces from the region, as this is the most reasonable solution for Washington, Army Spokesperson Mohammad Akraminia has said.
"The reasonable solution for the United States is to recognize the realities, compensate the costs and leave the region.
This will ensure security in the region and bring the American people closer to prosperity," he wrote on his social media page X.
Akraminia added that all the problems of the US army in the region and the difficulties of the Americans are caused by Washington's mistakes in committing aggression against the Islamic republic.
On September 1, the United States Central Command reported a series of strikes on targets in Iran.
According to Press TV, explosions occurred on the country's southern coast, including on Qeshm Island and in several cities.
In response, Iran struck US military bases in the UAE, Jordan, Iraq and Bahrain.

stories.title: 'Italian opposition fragmented: No alternative leader, no other possible leader than Giorgia Meloni'
stories.summary: Alison Sargent is pleased to welcome Political analyst Lorenzo Pregliasco, co-founder of polling agency YouTrend and adjunct professor at the University of Bologna. He argues that Giorgia Meloni’s unusual longevity in office is best understood not simply as a record of political strength, but as the product of a carefully calibrated governing strategy. Meloni has maintained stability partly by avoiding structural reforms disruptive enough to mobilize multiple constituencies against her at once. Her dominance within Fratelli d’Italia, the absence of a credible alternative leader, and a fragmented opposition have reinforced that advantage.
